fields.title: [ticket-viewer][viewer-api] Add kanban table graph layout mode

fields.acceptance_criteria: 1. Graph settings expose a kanban/table layout mode that places tickets into state-based columns instead of the current free hierarchy layout. 2. Within each state column, nodes are vertically organized into dependency-ordered subcomponent groups so related dependency chains stay clustered together in stable row cells. 3. Each kanban cell can contain multiple nodes with soft local clustering that keeps intra-cell dependencies legible without collapsing distinct nodes onto the same position.
